threads.body: [Testing] The JAX-RS 1.0 entries immediately above still do not collect the controller-disabled default profile: `jaxrs-1.0-annotations/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:35-42` applies the controller flag and matching label to every `Test` task. That conflicts with this PR's stated goal and #20546's requirement that baseline suites use instrumentation defaults. Please split that module into an unlabeled default `test` and a separately labeled controller-telemetry variant, then register the variant here as done for 2.0/3.0.

replies.body:
Addressed in a2bbc9b0f4a252739d38ab88440b589a10d4dd3d.

The frozen JAX-RS 1.0 build forced controller telemetry and its metadata label onto every Test task. The baseline test now uses instrumentation defaults without a metadataConfig label, while a full-suite testControllerTelemetry variant enables and labels controller telemetry and is registered for collection and check. The existing v3 preview variant explicitly retains both enabled properties. Annotation and Jersey assertions cover both modes, including Jetty wildcard-route fallback when JAX-RS controller telemetry is disabled. All three profiles passed and their collected labels and scopes were verified.

threads.body: [Testing] `jaxrs-3.0-resteasy-6.0` below remains unsplit: its `build.gradle.kts:42-47` enables and labels controller telemetry for every test, so the collection list still has no controller-disabled default profile for this JAX-RS module. This contradicts the PR description and #20546's baseline-default requirement. Give RESTEasy 6.0 the same default/controller/experimental task split and register the controller variant here.

replies.body:
Addressed in a2bbc9b0f4a252739d38ab88440b589a10d4dd3d.

The frozen RESTEasy 6.0 build likewise enabled and labeled controller telemetry for every Test task. Its baseline is now unlabeled and uses instrumentation defaults; the new full-suite testControllerTelemetry variant applies the controller flag and matching label, is collected, and is wired into check. The experimental variant explicitly applies both flags matching its existing two-setting label. Shared latest-dependency configuration and denyUnsafe behavior are preserved. All three profiles passed and collected default output contains no JAX-RS controller scopes while enabled variants contain the RESTEasy scope.
